name: 90012 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90012 (Los Angeles) has 290 nonprofit organizations. 121 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 108 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90012 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90012 (Los Angeles) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
